claims.text: Gas-atomized AlCrFeNiSi powder is suitable feedstock for conventional high-energy additive manufacturing.
Cold spray consolidates AlCrFeNiSi powder through high-velocity particle impact at temperatures below the melting point.
Cold spray can fabricate sub-centimeter AlCrFeNiSi components on a cooled substrate under an inert atmosphere.
Particle velocity and stand-off distance must be optimized for cold-spray deposition of AlCrFeNiSi.
Cold spray will retain the powder's intrinsic microstructure.
Cold spray will minimize grain coarsening in deposited AlCrFeNiSi.
Retention of the powder microstructure and minimal grain coarsening will produce lower dislocation accumulation.
Retention of the powder microstructure and minimal grain coarsening will reduce thermally induced defects.
Depositing AlCrFeNiSi below its melting point eliminates the high thermal gradients associated with laser- or electron-beam melting.
Eliminating high thermal gradients prevents rapid-solidification stresses.
The milder thermal regime of cold spray avoids phase changes that degrade mechanical properties.
Conventional high-energy additive manufacturing induces residual stress in AlCrFeNiSi through high thermal loads.
Conventional high-energy additive manufacturing causes microstructural degradation in AlCrFeNiSi.
Cold-sprayed AlCrFeNiSi components will have significantly lower residual stress than comparable components made by high-thermal-load additive manufacturing.
Cold-sprayed AlCrFeNiSi components will have higher toughness than comparable components made by high-thermal-load additive manufacturing.
Cold-sprayed AlCrFeNiSi components will have higher ductility than comparable components made by high-thermal-load additive manufacturing.
The proposed effect applies to miniature components smaller than 1 cm.
Uncontrolled oxygen content and oxidation may reduce the effectiveness of cold spray for these components.
Full densification requires a suitable combination of particle velocity, substrate temperature, and gun stand-off distance.
